Thanks Elena — received all documents. Quick checklist from procurement/finops before we finalize: 

1) PO attribute mapping: we will use fields 'po_number' -> PO Number, 'invoice_reference' -> Invoice Reference, and 'remit_instructions' -> Remittance String. Can you confirm the exact remittance string you'd like on our payments (example: "ACERO|INV|<invoice_number>|APEX")?

2) ACH format: Jordan, can you confirm whether Redwood will send CCD or CTX for this supplier by default? If we need CTX for the 80-char structured remittance, we will enable it.

3) Micro-deposit window: Finance will run micro-deposits to validate account; Elena, please confirm you can accept two micro-deposits and reply with the amounts.

Next steps: once micro-deposits are validated and PO mapping confirmed, procurement will attach vendor to our next PO and mark 'payment_channel: ACH'. We also sent a vendor portal invite — please follow the link to accept (link below).

Vendor portal invite: https://vendor-portal.aceroffice.com/invite/MTg3NjQ=
